title: [Main]-Bin content Block Movement does not prevent outbound posting for negative adjustments and sales orders
summary: The posting logic for sales orders and negative adjustments now respects bin content block movement settings to prevent unauthorized outbound warehouse movements.
key_points: Bin content blocks are now checked during sales order posting to restrict movements
Negative inventory adjustments are prevented from bypassing bin movement restrictions
Warehouse management logic updated to enforce bin content block rules consistently
Changes applied across all localization layers (APAC, BE, CH, ES, FI, FR, GB, IT, NA, NO, RU, W1)
Tests added to verify bin block movement restrictions work correctly
